training_objective: Recognize delayed contact from an occluded alcove, keep movement disciplined through the chokepoint, and maintain a viable exit route.
assumptions: Scene Cartographer confirmed the horror corridor semantic export with entry, hallway_center, chokepoint, ambush_point, cover, observation_point, doorway, and exit anchors.
ScenarioDirector will verify NavMesh reachability from ambush_point toward exit before spawning actors.
The light barricade can shape movement at chokepoint without sealing the corridor.
Likelihood values are scenario sampling weights under training assumptions, not calibrated intelligence estimates.

events.rationale: chokepoint is linked to hallway_center and exit, so a light barricade creates a movement delay while preserving the entry to exit route.
ambush_point sits near chokepoint and links back through cover toward exit, supporting a concise delay-and-reposition training inject.
